caption: Native approach to authored northern marlback scrabbler; original player and kit.
visualReview: Static contact frame; actors small near upper edge. HUD and live NPC combat log readable; no attack pose captured.
timestampBasis: Source PNG filesystem modification time; capture coroutine waits end of frame but no per-image UTC stamp is emitted.

resolution.basis: PNG IHDR; throwing also reports runtime dimensions

formationNote: Actual authored/generated site described in caption; per-frame formation/profile metadata not emitted by native route.

player.basis: Visible focus/vitals; report confirms where present

dayBandBasis: Visible TIME HUD label; not assumed equivalent to underground sunlight.
tickBasis: Per-capture native observation where available; lair surrounding key steps or final combat state otherwise; null=not recorded.

graphics.source: scene serialized value; not a per-frame numeric camera measurement
graphics.fullRevealBasis: ReferenceGlade serialized0 and shared native route guard asserts RevealEntire3DZone=false and FullReveal=false before selected captures

nativeRoute.alterations: ordinary queued keyboard input; no actor transfers, grants, stat changes, AI suppression or direct combat calls; actual original dagger and one original starting Rime Grip use, zero healing tonics

unknownMetadata: numeric camera transform and orthographic size
